# Contributor fixture

`tag-checks.json` retains the expected names and outcomes from the historically
qualified tag suite. It prevents the contributor policy from quietly dropping
coverage. Other qualification tests generate small cross-file fixtures and
verify identity, module, capability, lifecycle, and failure requirements.

Retired transcript-test source remains in Git at `c08fe22`; its obsolete local
run packets were removed from public history. See the
[privacy cleanup](../../../docs/qualification/history-cleanup.md) and
[current qualification status](../../../docs/qualification/README.md).
